name: multi-column-kanban-board
title: Multi Column Kanban Board
description: Horizontal scrolling kanban workspace with responsive column rails and card racks.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Kanban Column Horizontal Flow: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
